blockers.title: box_witness_pair_underivable resists proof with the scoped hypothesis list; the multi-diamond-witness case needs a hypothesis beyond h_Kdia
blockers.goal_shape: DerivExcludes (modalDerivationSystem Axioms) {phi | exists B, phi = Proposition.box B and B not in u.val} (modalDeductiveClosure Axioms (w.val union {phi | exists A, phi = Proposition.diamond A and A in u.val})), given h_sub : forall psi, (Proposition.box psi) in w.val -> psi in u.val
blockers.what_was_tried: Extensive manual derivation attempting to discharge each diamond hypothesis (diamond A_j, for A_j in u.val) used in a finite witness list via the ordinary deduction theorem (hasDeductionTheorem), aiming to necessitate the resulting implication chain and invoke K-diamond (h_Kdia : box(A -> B) -> (diamond A -> diamond B)) to relate the boxed disjunction bigOr l to something concluding B_i in u.val via h_sub + u's disjunction property. This structurally fails: discharging 'diamond A_j' via the deduction theorem always yields 'diamond A_j' (not plain 'A_j') as the antecedent of the resulting implication, and K-diamond's hypothesis position requires an UNMODALIZED antecedent inside the box (box(A -> B), not box(diamond A -> B)). No sequence of discharge orders or necessitation placements resolves this shape mismatch using only h_implyK, h_implyS, h_efq, h_orE, h_orI1, h_orI2, h_K, h_Kdia.
blockers.root_cause_found: Fetched and read the actual reference mechanization this phase is grounded on (ianshil/CK, theories/Completeness_th/general_th_completeness.v, Box case, lines ~211-249, via raw.githubusercontent.com/ianshil/CK/main/theories/Completeness_th/general_th_completeness.v). It proves the exact analogue of this sub-lemma using NOT ONLY Kd (K-diamond, matches our h_Kdia exactly per theories/GHC/CKH.v:25) BUT ALSO the Fischer-Servi axiom Idb A B := (diamond A -> box B) -> box (A -> B) (theories/GHC/CKH.v:34), invoked at general_th_completeness.v:231 via 'apply Ax ; right ; right ; eexists ; eexists ; right ; reflexivity' to convert a derived fact of shape '(diamond (conj of witnesses)) -> (box (list_disj l'))' into 'box ((conj of witnesses) -> (list_disj l'))' -- precisely the missing bridge step. Report 02's claim that this sub-lemma 'depends only on the axioms AxiomK and K-diamond' is not supported by the very reference it cites for the construction.
blockers.recommended_fix: Add h_Idb : forall A B, Axioms (((Proposition.diamond A).imp (Proposition.box B)).imp (Proposition.box (A.imp B))) as an explicit new parametric hypothesis to box_witness_pair_underivable and (downstream) canonical_box_witness (Phase 2b). Re-plan via /revise 480 or a narrowly-scoped /research 480 --hard --lit pass on 'Idb / Fischer-Servi axiom, ianshil/CK Idb, theories/GHC/CKH.v' before re-dispatching Phase 2b-sublemma. Also verify (not done this dispatch) whether Phase 2c (canonical_diamond_witness) needs the dual axiom Cd A B := diamond(A or B) -> (diamond A or diamond B) (theories/GHC/CKH.v:33) -- the diamond case of general_th_completeness.v was not read closely enough this dispatch to confirm either way.
blockers.postmortem_note: This is not a re-litigation of an already-settled design decision under the 'no re-opening without a concrete counterexample' rule -- the counterexample is the reference mechanization itself, fetched and read in this dispatch, showing the report's H3 hypothesis-list claim for this specific sub-lemma was incomplete.

plan_deviations: prime_set_exclusion takes one additional explicit hypothesis beyond report 02's literal Deliverable-1 signature: bot_mem_cl_of_not_cons : forall {X}, not (Cons X) -> HasBot.bot in cl X. This is the set-exclusion analogue of prime_exclusion's phi_mem_cl_of_not_cons bridge (targeting the canonical bigOr [] = bot rather than a fixed phi). Report 02's sketch says the inconsistent branch gets 'insert X T |- bot' for free, but a fully generic Cons predicate cannot supply that without an explicit bridge hypothesis; this addition keeps the lemma correct, zero-debt, and instantiable exactly as modal_prime_exclusion instantiates the analogous phi_mem_cl_of_not_cons (trivially, from the definition of ModalSetConsistent).
